scope: Five current parked cards and one historical C02 compatibility card; three W01 basis descriptions updated for T-2793 with openings/other fields preserved. C02 has no scene placement.

sidecar.name: Farm-box wagon

placement.position_note: A refined unhitched farm-box type replaces the previous vehicle at the same reconstructed stand and bearing. Maker, owner, cargo and finish are unidentified. The existing yard source supports the kind of setting, not this exact wagon.

vehicle_type.note: Original reconstructed farm-box geometry follows the existing 1835 yard envelope, with individual boards and iron hardware. Timber color and finish use modern CC0 wood texture maps and remain reconstructed; no historic specimen, species, coating, manufacturer or model is identified.

maker.note: This model is not identified as a particular manufacturer or catalog model.

parked.note: A parked example, without a driver, passengers or a claim of ownership.

sidecar.name: Covered wagon — blue and oxide

placement.position_note: An empty, unhitched reconstructed covered type at its unchanged earlier stand and bearing; the old stable identity determines its distinct finish and canvas aging. The original laid-by yoke is retained, not attached to a team. No owner, maker, driver or cargo is identified; riding and boarding are unavailable.

vehicle_type.note: Original empty covered-wagon reconstruction with faded blue body and oxide running gear, open canvas ends, bows, restrained seams/folds and a laid-by ox yoke. The original record ID and exact coordinates retain its seeded finish family and canvas aging. Canvas construction, color, wear and bows are reconstructed; no manufacturer, historical owner or load is identified. Source-owned donor bench/footboard were omitted; occupied, driver, hitch, collision, riding and boarding interfaces are unsupported.

maker.note: This model is not identified as a particular manufacturer or catalog model.

parked.note: A parked example, without a driver, passengers or a claim of ownership.
